description: Door check-in for events at small charities and churches: find a returning guest in a few keystrokes, add a new one (or a whole family) in seconds, live headcount, works offline, name-only data, backup/restore. Download the who-is-here list for a spreadsheet and print it. Later phases: fuller attendance reports, kiosk self-check-in.
adapters: static-web packaging (done, plus build-single-file.js and optional sw.js)

config_schema.org: string, name shown at top (edited inside the app)
